name: interior-desing
description: Create, furnish, surface, light, render, and review Blender interiors with native Cycles and reusable 3D assets.

interface.shortDescription: Build and refine Blender interiors with Cycles.
interface.longDescription: Seven focused skills cover interior workflows, reference matching and scene assembly, model discovery, native Cycles materials, photographic lighting and rendering, exact viewer-camera image exports, and evidence-based visual refinement. Uses the runtime's existing Blender MCP connection and preserves editable scene checkpoints.
defaultPrompt: Recreate this interior reference in Blender and render it with Cycles.
Improve this room's materials and lighting while preserving its layout.
Find a free, realistic electric kettle model for a Three.js kitchen.
